_doc: Final gimbal (servo gimbal, axes through the CoG of the measured 370 x 50 mm antenna): values derived from the CAD for the MATLAB/Simulink model (final_model/sim). Generated by build_gimbal.py.

geometry.h_note: residual CoG offset assumed for the sim (+ = above the axes); nominal geometry puts the CoG on the axes. Sweep 0..0.020 m.
geometry.L_note: side of the square plate with the same inertia about a diameter as the 370 x 50 mm disc

inertia_kgm2.note: uniform disc; a rim-heavy antenna (metal band) can be up to ~2x on the antenna term

m1_note: roll frame + pitch servo + pitch bearings/linkage, aluminium frame

servo.w0_note: no-load speed (rad/s) at 6.0 V, interpolated from the seller spec
servo.backlash_note: roll = servo + 1:1 linkage (2 ball links), pitch now ALSO through a 1:1 linkage -> consider 0.5 deg on both axes

delays_same_as_design_A.note: Andrii's assumptions (400 Hz attitude, 333 Hz servo frame, ~40-50 ms total). Market-benchmark check: ArduPilot's servo mount backend runs at ~50 Hz -> add up to 20 ms in a sensitivity case.
